title: Simple Essentials
description: A minecraft mod that adds the basic essentials!
body:
##  **_Information_**

Simple Essentials is a client based minecraft mod that displays not so important, but could be important stuff, It displays the simple essentials!

## **_Features_** 

Most of the features are on the top left side of your screen.
It goes like this:

FPS: <your current fps>
XYZ: <coordinates>
Yaw: <your yaw>
CPS: <left click counts>

Theres also one external feature alongside this that barely gives much effects but still works.

/bfullbright - Makes caves brighter, It's not very strong, to make it still feel vanilla 

## **_Why download?_**

You should download this mod because it's very good if you're a content creator or just a standalone person that wants to see how well your pc runs in minecraft, or maybe you just want a glance at your coordinates to master singleplayer words? It all works, and its right here, just a few clicks away from you.

## **_Installation_**

If you dont know how to install mods or you're just new in general, here's how to install it.

1. Download to mod from here, more versions might come in the future
2. locate your ".minecraft" folder and find "mods". There are plenty of tutorials online on how to find this.
3. Drag the mod named "simpleessentials-X.X.X.jar" and drag it into that folder
4. Download fabric api from modrinth and drag that into your mod folder aswell
5. Then make sure your on fabric!
6. Lastly launch your minecraft with fabric and hop on a singleplayer world to test it out!

Now you have it running! Excellent work
